about: Blocky case terrain grid for Big Sur. Layer values are x10 integers (null = no data); row 0 = north. Written by tools/process_big_sur.py.
block_text: one block = 8×8 filtered pixels of 30 m = 24×24 NISAR 10 m pixels ≈ 240 m

layers.label: Burned share of each block
layers.what: Share of the block our rule calls burned (HV fell ≥ 2 dB, patches ≥ 5 ha)
